method: Independent analytic derivation with numerical checks, separate from rendered labels
claims: For unit inversion p maps to p/|p| squared. Distances are reciprocal and a second inversion is identity. A line x=a nonzero maps to x prime squared + y prime squared = x prime/a: circle centered (1/(2a),0), radius 1/(2|a|), excluding origin.

Triangles OAP and OPprimeAprime share the angle at O and have proportional sides because reciprocal distances reverse the ratios; the image angle at Pprime is right. Lines through origin map to themselves with origin excluded. Only finite drawn line portions are sampled; the full circle minus origin represents the infinite line.

checks.description: Mapped line points satisfy circle equation
No finite sampled point maps to origin

limitations: Numerical samples check implementations; general conclusions rest on the stated mathematical arguments.
